Name: Fortunate Foot
Author: PurelyInZane
Description:
Fortunate Foot is a mod for Stardew Valley that enhances the gameplay experience by providing luck buffs to the player based on the quality of the Rabbit's Foot item in their inventory. The mod adds an extra layer of excitement and rewards players who manage to obtain high-quality Rabbit's Foot items.

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Grants luck buffs to the player based on the quality of the Rabbit's Foot item in their inventory.
[*]The luck bonus increases with higher quality Rabbit's Foot items (normal, silver, gold, and iridium).
[*]The luck buff is applied dynamically and updates in real time as the player's inventory changes.
[*]Configurable luck values for each quality level using the Generic Mod Config Menu.
[*]Seamless integration with the game, providing a balanced and immersive experience.
[/list]
[b]How It Works:[/b]
Upon installing the mod, it will automatically detect the presence of Rabbit's Foot items in the player's inventory. The mod will scan the inventory and identify the highest quality Rabbit's Foot item present. Based on the quality of the item, a corresponding luck buff will be applied to the player.

The luck buffs for each quality level can be customized using the Generic Mod Config Menu. Players can adjust the luck values according to their preferences, allowing for a personalized gameplay experience.

As the player's inventory changes throughout the game, the mod will dynamically update the luck buff based on the current highest quality Rabbit's Foot item present. This ensures that the player always receives the appropriate luck bonus.

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
Fortunate Foot is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5 and above. The mod requires [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b] (version 4.0.0 or higher) to be installed for the mod to work. It also requires the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (version 1.0.0 or higher) to be installed for accessing the configuration options.

[b]Installation:[/b]
To install the mod, simply download the mod file and install it using your preferred mod manager or by manually placing the files in your Stardew Valley Mods folder. Make sure to install any required dependencies, such as SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu. Then run the game using SMAPI.

[b]Conclusion:[/b]
Fortunate Foot adds an exciting new dimension to Stardew Valley by rewarding players for obtaining high-quality Rabbit's Foot items. With configurable luck buffs and seamless integration, this mod enhances the gameplay experience and provides an extra incentive for players to seek out and collect these valuable items. Enjoy the increased luck and the benefits it brings to your farming adventures in Stardew Valley!

Side note:
This is my first mod, I hope you all can enjoy it!
